coverage: All eleven local sections of both English editions: named cast, two messengers, distinct worshipper groups, recognizable unnamed roles and named mythological or personified references.

entities.name: Dionysus
entities.body: The god of wine and ecstatic worship, son of Zeus and Semele, appearing in human form.

entities.name: Pentheus
entities.body: The king of Thebes, son of Agave and Echion, and grandson of Cadmus.

entities.name: Cadmus
entities.body: The founder and former king of Thebes, grandfather of Pentheus and Dionysus.

entities.name: Agave
entities.body: Pentheus’s mother, daughter of Cadmus and sister of Semele.

entities.name: The chorus of Asian Bacchants
entities.body: The women from Asia who accompany Dionysus and worship him.

entities.name: The chorus leader
entities.body: The spokeswoman for the Asian women who follow Dionysus.

entities.name: The Theban Bacchants
entities.body: The women of Thebes gathered on the mountain under Dionysus’s influence.

entities.name: Teiresias
entities.body: The blind prophet of Thebes and old friend of Cadmus. Also spelled Tiresias.

entities.name: Autonoe
entities.body: Agave’s sister and Actaeon’s mother, one of the daughters of Cadmus.

entities.name: Ino
entities.body: Agave’s sister, one of the daughters of Cadmus.

entities.name: The soldier
entities.body: The officer commanding Pentheus’s guards.

entities.name: Pentheus’s guards
entities.body: The soldiers serving the king of Thebes.

entities.name: The herdsman messenger
entities.body: The herdsman who reports on the women’s activities on the mountain.

entities.name: Pentheus’s attendant
entities.body: The servant who accompanies Pentheus to the mountain and returns as a messenger.

entities.name: The townsman among the herdsmen
entities.body: The town-experienced man who proposes capturing Agave in the herdsman’s account.

entities.name: Semele
entities.body: Dionysus’s mother, a daughter of Cadmus and sister of Agave.

entities.name: Echion
entities.body: Pentheus’s father and Agave’s husband, one of the earth-born warriors of Thebes.

entities.name: Harmonia
entities.body: Cadmus’s wife, a daughter of Ares.

entities.name: Agenor
entities.body: Cadmus’s father, associated with the family’s origins in Phoenicia.

entities.name: Actaeon
entities.body: The hunter, son of Autonoe and nephew of Agave, recalled as a warning.

entities.name: Actaeon’s father
entities.body: The father of the hunter Actaeon, recalled by Cadmus at the end of the play.

entities.name: Zeus
entities.body: The chief Olympian god and father of Dionysus.

entities.name: Hera
entities.body: Zeus’s wife, whose hostility to Semele is recalled in the play.

entities.name: Rhea
entities.body: The mother goddess associated here with the invention of the ritual drum.

entities.name: Cybele
entities.body: The Phrygian mother goddess whose mountain rites are celebrated by the chorus.

entities.name: Aphrodite
entities.body: The goddess of love, also called the Cyprian.

entities.name: Demeter
entities.body: The goddess of grain and the earth’s nourishment.

entities.name: Ares
entities.body: The god of war and father of Harmonia.

entities.name: Apollo
entities.body: The god of prophecy, also called Phoebus.

entities.name: Artemis
entities.body: The goddess of the hunt, invoked in the warning about Actaeon.

entities.name: Orpheus
entities.body: The legendary musician whose song charms trees and wild animals.

entities.name: Pan
entities.body: The god of shepherds and wild places.

entities.name: The nymphs
entities.body: The female nature spirits invoked in the mountain setting.

entities.name: The Muses
entities.body: The goddesses of song and the arts.

entities.name: The satyrs
entities.body: The wild companion spirits of Dionysus, associated with dancing and revelry.

entities.name: The Corybant
entities.body: One of the armed ritual dancers associated with the mother goddess.

entities.name: Achelous
entities.body: The river god named as Dirce’s father. Also spelled Acheloues.

entities.name: Dirce
entities.body: The sacred Theban water personified as a daughter of Achelous.

entities.name: Purity
entities.body: The divine power of holiness addressed by the chorus.

entities.name: Peace
entities.body: Peace personified as the nurturer of children, beloved by Dionysus.

entities.name: Justice
entities.body: Justice personified and invoked by the chorus.

entities.name: The spirit of earthquake
entities.body: The power of earthquake summoned by Dionysus.
